audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks Courage (W) as the matchup-defining cooldown. The ability that actually decides the lane is Decisive Strike (Q): an 8s flat-cooldown silence that cancels the re-E or the W steroid mid-combo.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: a move-speed burst that breaks slows, and the next attack silences. That both dodges your Bear Trap slow and shuts off the second half of your combo — Courage only reduces damage.
audit.corrected: Decisive Strike's 8s silence made the engage gate in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5]; Courage kept with its real 22s rank-1 number as a secondary.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 1-5 contradicted the packet chart while this page's own whys already agreed with the packet — whys[1] literally opens 'Even' against a Kled row, whys[2] and whys[3] describe Garen owning the tempo against Skill rows, whys[4] says 'Coin-flip at 6' against a Kled row, whys[5] describes his spike against a Skill row.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Garen / Garen / Skill / Garen / Garen, and the mirror audit states it realigned win[1..5] and phases[1..6] onto that same packet chart with Level 1 left to Kled.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Skill / Garen / Garen / Skill / Garen, ratings moved with them. Row 0 (Kled) and row 6 (Garen) already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer wrote 'Beartrap' instead of Bear Trap on a Rope. The silence-cancels-re-E interaction and Demacian Justice's true-damage execute on a dismounted Kled were absent from the full layer entirely.
audit.why: Kled's E is a dash out with a re-cast dash back; a silence between the two halves strands you next to him with no return. Demacian Justice carries trueDamage and execute flags and Kled's dismounted form is the low-health state that feeds it. Decisive Strike is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, the silence written into the do's, cooldowns and report[5], and the execute-on-dismount written into the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early, content.mid and content.late were written in the first person ('my re-E', 'I keep my E and R'), breaking the second-person coaching voice.
audit.why: The approved bar is the user's second-person voice throughout.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person at the same length; content otherwise preserved because the mechanical claims were already right.

edits.after: Bear Trap Garen once his Q silence is spent, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount.

edits.before: Garen concedes nothing at level 1 — he Q-silences to cancel my re-E or W steroid mid-cast, empowered-strikes my Skaarl bar, and his passive regen heals back any poke I land while I have no spammable tool to answer. So I don't trade into a held Q. Level 2-3 is my window: once W Violent Tendencies and the E-W-E re-E all-in are online, an overstepping Garen eats my Bear Trap percent-HP Q, the on-hit shotgun shots, and the marked return strike before his W tenacity exists to shrug it. Bait the Q silence first, then commit so he can't cut the combo.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 tilt to him. Garen short-trades with Q empowered-strike into W damage-cut, then disengages out of my follow-up, and his regen tops off between trades faster than I can keep Skaarl's bar full. I keep my E and R for sticking power, not for diving into a full-health Garen with W up. At 6 it's a true coin-flip: my R Chaaaaaaaaarge gives me the engage and knockback his kit can't escape, but his R is a missing-HP true execute that bursts my weaker dismounted form the instant my mount bar drops — whoever forces the all-in on the other's cooldown wins it.

edits.before: Once Garen finishes Stridebreaker or Trinity he owns the lane pattern: his Q silence pins my combo, his W cuts my W on-hit burst, and he short-trades then walks away before my percent-HP Q chews him down, with his R execute always looming over a dismount. I can't snowball this off raw stats the way I do into a Darius or Sett. My plan is to have already cashed my level 2-3 and 6 windows, then use R to roam and create plays on the map rather than forcing a losing 1v1 — and to never get caught dismounted in his Q-W-R range.

notes: The brief reports games 1175 at the top level but 698 inside the packet for the same matchup — worth checking which number the page renders. Executioner's Calling in report[8] is correct from this side (Grievous Wounds does reduce Perseverance regen), unlike the mirror's copy of that line on Garen's page, which the mirror auditor flagged.
